offers_products.reason: Cultivates and manufactures branded cannabis products (Dogwalkers, Incredibles, &Shine) sold at its RISE stores and wholesale.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling cannabis goods via retail and wholesale; no main service offering beyond retail.

sells_to_consumers.reason: RISE dispensaries sell directly to adult-use customers and medical patients.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Wholesales branded products to third-party dispensaries that resell them.

recurring_revenue.reason: Consumers and patients repeatedly buy cannabis products at dispensaries; consumable, habitual purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Cannabis is a low-priced consumable bought regularly, and customers rarely cut it much in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Typical dispensary purchases of flower, edibles and vapes are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for cannabis goods the company grows, makes and sells, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual consumers and patients, plus independent dispensaries.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs cultivation and manufacturing facilities plus a growing network of owned or leased RISE retail stores.
